[card] Draft: quadratic bent point-flip selector  (id: claim_20cd9397d18ea90845a8cbb0b70c0d11c9b6d1ad51fec7fbb15eb06c4f8b4796; claim)
    DRAFT: independent mathematical referee review pending; no novelty claim. For even n>=2, t in F_2^n, let g(t)=(-1)^(sum_{j=1}^{n/2} t_{2j-1}t_{2j}), h(t)=g(t)-2*1_{t=0}, and F(t,+1)=g(t), F(t,-1)=h(t). Both restrictions and F are Boolean. With p=2^-n, I_z(F)=p and Delta_z H(F)/p>=n-4/ln 2. Also I(F)=n/2+(n+1)p and H(F)/I(F) tends to 2. Thus this family refutes an every-coordinate linear charge, without refuting full FEI. Uniform Boolean cube Base-2 Fourier entropy including the empty coefficient 0 log(1/0)=0 Even n>=2 Specified selector coordinate z

[card] Draft: retain the coordinate quantifier in FEI induction  (id: claim_6c9b61232a4d7e1a20206abc20a2792ec1c1dce33e488886f42b9a08cc4607ef; claim)
    DRAFT: independent mathematical referee review pending; no novelty claim. A restriction induction for a Boolean class closed under restrictions needs a uniform K and, for every f in the class, existence of a coordinate i with Delta_i H(f)<=K I_i(f). The quadratic bent point-flip selector has a bad selector coordinate, but each original coordinate has influence 1/2+2^-n and split increment at most 2, so its split ratio is below 4. A specified bad coordinate cannot refute this existential premise. Uniform Boolean cube Base-2 Fourier entropy including the empty coefficient 0 log(1/0)=0 Class closed under restrictions for the proposed induction
